list.name: station
list.label: 站點
list.query:
SELECT station_name || ' [' || station_id || ']' AS __text, station_id AS __value
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_id) station_id, station_name, source_at
      FROM station_history WHERE district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
      ORDER BY station_id, source_at DESC) AS stations
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 早尖峰・缺車排行
panels.description: 所選日期內各站分別累計。僅有效樣本至少24筆才列入；缺車與缺位各以同一組有效觀測為分母，比例可同時發生。沒有合格站點時不顯示排行，請看上方資料狀態與下方明細。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT station_id AS "站號", (array_agg(station_name ORDER BY source_at DESC))[1] AS "站點",
       (array_agg(district ORDER BY source_at DESC))[1] AS "行政區",
       count(*) AS "有效樣本數",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_bikes = 0) / count(*), 2) AS "缺車比例",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_docks = 0) / count(*), 2) AS "缺位比例"
FROM station_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(source_at)
  AND district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND valid_sample AND peak = '早尖峰'
GROUP BY station_id
HAVING count(*) >= 24
ORDER BY "缺車比例" DESC, station_id

panels.title: 尖峰樣本與比例明細（含未達24筆）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT station_id AS "站號", (array_agg(station_name ORDER BY source_at DESC))[1] AS "站點",
       (array_agg(district ORDER BY source_at DESC))[1] AS "行政區",
       peak AS "尖峰", count(*) AS "有效樣本數",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_bikes = 0) / count(*), 2) AS "缺車比例",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_docks = 0) / count(*), 2) AS "缺位比例",
       CASE WHEN count(*) >= 24 THEN '達排行門檻' ELSE '未達24筆，不列排行' END AS "排行資格"
FROM station_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(source_at)
  AND district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND valid_sample AND peak IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY station_id, peak
ORDER BY station_id, peak

panels.title: 單站歷史資料狀態
panels.description: 上方站點選單選擇一個站號；單站歷史涵蓋所選日期的全部時段，觀測點只顯示有效觀測，明細保留不合格原因。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT station_id) FROM station_history WHERE district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])) <> 1 THEN '請選擇單一站點查看歷史'
    WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN '無資料'
    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_sample) = 0 THEN '無資料（觀測皆不合格，見歷史明細）'
    ELSE '單站歷史：有效 ' || count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_sample)::text || ' / 全部 ' || count(*)::text || ' 筆'
END AS "歷史狀態"
FROM station_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(source_at)
  AND district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: 單站可借車數與可還空位
panels.description: 時間為臺灣時間。只以觀測點顯示實際有效資料，不連線、不補零、不推算缺報或不合格時段。資料尚未採集或全數不合格時，請看上方「無資料」提示。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source_at AS time, available_bikes AS "可借車數", available_docks AS "可還空位"
FROM station_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(source_at)
  AND district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND valid_sample AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT station_id) FROM station_history WHERE district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])) = 1
ORDER BY source_at

panels.title: 單站歷史明細（含不合格觀測）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(source_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "來源時間",
       station_id AS "站號", station_name AS "站點", district AS "行政區",
       available_bikes AS "可借車數", available_docks AS "可還空位",
       sample_status AS "觀測狀態", coalesce(peak, '非平日尖峰') AS "時段"
FROM station_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(source_at)
  AND district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT station_id) FROM station_history WHERE district = ANY(ARRAY[${district:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND station_id = ANY(ARRAY[${station:sqlstring}]::text[])) = 1
ORDER BY source_at

options.content:
臺灣時間週一至週五：早尖峰 **07:00 ≤ 來源時間 < 09:00**；晚尖峰 **17:00 ≤ 來源時間 < 19:00**。日期範圍使用上方時間選擇器，各尖峰分別累計。

有效觀測須營運中，且首次採集時來源年齡介於0至30分鐘（含邊界）；停用、過期、來源時間在未來或缺報不計入。相同站號與來源時間重抓只算一筆。有效樣本至少24筆才排行；明細可查不足24筆。未採集期間無資料，不補零。
